Only sampled native text/json message content is inspected: protoPayload, otel, httpRequest, labels/other metadata, audit metadata, other history/log views and other services outside Logging are not inspected.
Routed/foreign logName and numeric-to-project-ID aliases remain UNKNOWN without an independent authoritative alias join.
Fixed page/message ordinals are unstable across reruns; investigate the exact project/window query. No durable logName/insertId owner or automatic per-entry remediation is asserted.
